features.name: any_counter_comment_markdown_emphasis
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain markdown bold or italic formatting?

h0: any_counter_comment_markdown_emphasis has no association with delta.
h1: Rows with counter-argument comments containing markdown bold/italic have higher delta probability than rows without.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as the OP changed view (delta) at row level; association only. Comments are not individually linked to outcomes, so the formatted comment may not be the persuasive one. Row-level 'any' is an assumption (alternatives: share of formatted comments). Regex may catch literal asterisks/underscores (e.g., snake_case, lists) and misses formatting stripped from the data. Raw text may contain outcome announcements; no timing information.
